interpretation_note: This file records the Phase 1 gate as assessed on 2026-10-09 at commit 400ecef. 'phase2_ready' meant only that application development could begin on top of the engine. It is NOT evidence that the required algorithm capabilities, the product, production deployment, or the licensing of data/model assets are complete or suitable for release.

installation.evidence: uv.lock (Python 3.12.3) + requirements.lock.txt; `uv run petperception doctor` exit 0; Docker image built and run

real_audio_path.evidence: YAMNet TFLite on real ESC-50 audio (E1, integration test test_real_yamnet_detects_esc50_cat_and_ignores_silence)

real_visual_path.evidence: EfficientDet-Lite0 on 823 real Open Images photos (E4); tracker/camera-motion on scenario videos (E5)

unified_cli_api.evidence: CLI analyze and API /v1/analyses use the same AnalysisEngine and schema 1.0.0; tests/test_api.py full lifecycle with the real engine; Docker API round-trip

artifact_availability.evidence: model files fetchable with pinned SHA-256 (fetch-models); fitted thresholds committed in artifacts/ with terms

regression_tests.evidence: 54 passed: split leakage, timestamp alignment, corrupt/silent/no-audio inputs, no-pet input, multi-pet attribution, unsupported pose features, missing models, schema validation, invalid uploads, deterministic deletion, uncertainty behaviour

engineering_ready.notes: Synthetic/mocked tests are marked and do not substitute for the real E1/E4 runs.

E1_audio_events.dataset: ESC-50 @33c8ce9e, 2000 clips (40 cat, 40 dog, 1920 other), checksums verified
E1_audio_events.protocol: 5 official source-preserving folds; inner leave-one-fold-out; nested F1-optimal thresholds; bootstrap over 1524 Freesound sources

E2_cat_recording_context.reason: CatMeows unreachable: zenodo.org denied by the workspace egress policy
E2_cat_recording_context.implemented: Zenodo MD5-verified fetch, filename parser, leave-one-cat-out + leave-one-owner-out, inner grouped C, cat bootstrap, leakage diagnostic

E3_dog_activity_context.reason: Barkopedia unreachable (huggingface.co denied) and media provenance/grouping unaudited

E4_visual_detection.dataset: Open Images V7 validation subset, 823 images, human-verified labels
E4_visual_detection.protocol: per-class verified images only; depiction/group-of ignored; AP@0.5; operating threshold 0.35 fixed a priori; author bootstrap
E4_visual_detection.tracking_metrics: not_evaluated (no labelled cat/dog tracking video reachable)
E4_visual_detection.pose_metrics: not_evaluated (no verified animal pose model or set)

E6_runtime.hardware: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon 2.10 GHz, 15.7 GB RAM, no GPU

phase2_ready.justification: The service is usable (CLI, API, Docker), the result contract is versioned (1.0.0) with OpenAPI and JSON Schema, and every limitation (experimental fusion, uncalibrated scores, unavailable pose, blocked datasets, quality flags, abstention reasons) is exposed in the output for an observation-first research PWA. Lack of household intent validation does not block an honest observation-first PWA.
conditions_for_phase2: PWA must present observations first and label hypotheses as experimental/uncalibrated
add TLS and production authentication before any non-local deployment
do not display scores as percentages or confidences
phase2_ready.meaning: readiness to begin application development only
